business_problem: Laris Hotels Group is one of the largest hotel chains in Krakow, Poland, and wanted more timely access to booking data across its network. To replace a weekly manual process, the company used desktop robotic process automation (RPA) in Power Automate to pull data daily from a legacy system that did not offer an API.
solution_summary: Laris Hotels Group is one of the largest hotel chains in Krakow, Poland, and wanted more timely access to booking data across its network. To replace a weekly manual process, the company used desktop robotic process automation (RPA) in Power Automate to pull data daily from a legacy system that did not offer an API. With faster access to fully customized data in Power BI, the company now has a clearer view of booking data, with average hotel occupancy increasing by approximately 15%. The company uses a dedicated property management system (PMS) to manage bookings. The system tracks bookings made directly with each hotel and is also integrated with various reservation channels that Laris customers use, such as Booking.com, Expedia, and Airbnb. One limitation of the system for Laris is that the system doesn't provide aggregated information across hotels. This made it difficult to analyze booking trends over time.
